blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Names carry demographic indicators such as age, gender, and race, which makes them a subtle but strong target of bias in large language models (LLMs). In this work, we present an evaluation of name-based bias across 6 local large language models spanning multiple providers and parameter scales. Using a fill-in-the-blank task, we prompt these models to choose between pairs of first names drawn from U.S. Social Security Administration datasets and a race classification dataset by Rosenman et al.. Our experimental de- sign isolates age and gender effects through balanced name pairings and sentence templates that share a fixed syntactic structure. Across 300,000 local LLM responses, we find consistent and measurable name bias. Models prefer names that are less stereotypically male, older, popular, and white. Furthermore, we find that name-bias is highly sentence-dependent, but not more than associated stereotypes, and gender is the most significant bias, followed by age, name popularity, and race. Our results demonstrate that name-based bias remains pervasive even in local LLMs, highlighting the necessity for standardized evaluation methods and mitigation strategies.
blocks.zh: 名称带有年龄,性别和种族等人口指标,这使得它们成为了大语言模型(LLMs)中偏颇的微妙而强烈的目标. 在这项工作中,我们评价了6个地方大语言模型的基于名称的偏差,这些模型跨越多个提供者和参数尺度。 使用填充式任务,我们促使这些模型在从美国社会保障管理局数据集抽取的一对名字和由罗森曼等所绘制的种族分类数据集之间进行选择. 我们的实验去标志通过平衡的名字配对和句子模板来隔离年龄和性别效应,这些模板具有固定的合成结构. 在30万个地方的LLM反应中,我们发现一致和可衡量的名称偏差。 模特更喜欢男性,年长,受欢迎和白人的定型名字. 此外,我们发现, " 有名之辈 " 高度依赖判决,但并不超出相关的定型观念,性别是最重要的偏见,其次是年龄、名声和种族。 我们的结果显示,即使在当地有限责任公司中,基于名称的偏见仍然普遍存在,这突出说明了标准化评价方法和缓解战略的必要性。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large Language Model usage has surged dramatically, with nearly 50% of U.S. adults reporting they have used LLMs for daily tasks at least once Rainie (2025) . These systems often handle natural language prompts that include personal names. Since names can encode demographic cues such as age, gender, and race, even minor model biases may lead to discriminatory outcomes. Such biases may perpetuate stereotypes, unfairly advantage certain groups, or generate harmful content. Identifying and measuring these biases is therefore essential: it enables more rigorous model evaluation, supports the development of fairer systems, and advances transparency in AI safety.
blocks.zh: 近50%的美国成年人报告说, 他们至少一次使用LLMS做日常工作(2025年)。 这些系统经常处理包含个人姓名的自然语言提示. 由于地名可以编码年龄、性别和种族等人口提示,即使是轻微的模式偏见也可能导致歧视性结果。 这种偏见可能使定型观念永久化,不公平地有利于某些群体,或产生有害的内容。 因此,必须查明和衡量这些偏见:它能够进行更严格的模型评价,支持建立更公平的系统,提高AI安全的透明度。

blocks.en: Therefore, it remains integral to measure the biases LLMs can hold, and in this work, we address four specific biases: age, gender, popularity, and race. Our experiments prompt local LLMs with fill-in-the-blank sentences given two names that may reveal a specific bias, such as age, gender, or race. We measure • Age bias and popularity bias by collecting the top 500 most popular names, and how many times they were assigned, from the 1980s and 2010s • Gender bias by categorizing the most popular names from 1980s and 2010s as female and male • Racial bias by using a racial classification dataset provided by Rosenman et al. Our experiments and contributions can be found at https://github.com/cerenmert14/name-bias-in-local-llms
blocks.zh: 因此,衡量有限责任妇女可能持有的偏见仍然是不可或缺的,在这项工作中,我们处理四个具体的偏见:年龄、性别、受欢迎程度和种族。 我们的实验促使本地的LLMs 充满了空白的句子 给出了两个可能揭示特定偏见的名字,如年龄、性别或种族。 • 使用罗森曼等人提供的种族分类数据集,将1980年代和2010年代最受欢迎的名字归类为女性和男性。 我们的实验和贡献见https://github.com/cerenmert14/name-bias-in-local-llms。

blocks.en: Age bias and popularity bias by collecting the top 500 most popular names, and how many times they were assigned, from the 1980s and 2010s
blocks.zh: 从20世纪80年代到2010年代,通过收集最受欢迎的500个名次以及分配到多少次的名次,年龄偏好和受欢迎偏好

blocks.en: Gender bias by categorizing the most popular names from 1980s and 2010s as female and male
blocks.zh: 性别偏见,将1980年代和2010年代最受欢迎的名字分为女性和男性

blocks.en: Racial bias by using a racial classification dataset provided by Rosenman et al.
blocks.zh: 种族偏见 使用由罗森曼等提供的种族分类数据集.

blocks.en: 2 Prior Work
blocks.zh: 2 先前的工作

blocks.en: There has been a significant effort in exploring the biases LLMs hold. In fact, it has been found that large language models that seem to be “explicitly unbiased”, where they refuse overtly biased statements, still form implicit discriminatory biases Bai et al. (2025) . They observed that even common models like GPT-4, which refuses an explicitly biased statement such as “women are bad at managing people”, continue to prefer male names over female ones, to lead a management workshop.
blocks.zh: 已作出重大努力,探索有限责任公司持有的偏见。 事实上,人们发现,似乎“明显不带偏见”的大型语言模型在拒绝明显有偏见的言论时,仍然构成隐含的歧视性偏见Bai等人(2025年)。 他们指出,即使是普通模式,如GPT-4,拒绝“妇女不善于管理人”等明显有偏见的说法,仍然偏好男性而不是女性名称,领导管理讲习班。

blocks.en: Another study simulated hiring decisions and salary recommendations for candidates with first names that strongly signal their race and gender, and found a preference for hiring candidates with White female-sounding names over other demographic groups across 40 occupations Nghiem et al. (2024) . In addition, even among candidates with identical qualifications, outputted salary recommendations varied by up to 5% between different subgroups.
blocks.zh: 另一项研究模拟了对姓名明显表明其种族和性别的候选人的雇用决定和薪金建议,发现在Nghiem等人(2024年)的40个职业中,聘用白人女性名字的候选人优于其他人口群体。 此外,即使在资历相同的候选人中,不同分组之间产出的薪金建议差异可达5%。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 First Name Data Collection
blocks.zh: 3.1 名字数据收集

blocks.en: To collect popular names from 1980s and 2010s for our experiments, we utilize the Social Security Administration’s top baby names dataset . We sort the names by their gender and popularity, and only use the top 500 names. Additionally, we have used the dataset provided by Rosenman et al. (2023) for racial classification of the names.
blocks.zh: 为了收集20世纪80年代和2010年代的流行地名,我们使用社会保障局的婴儿顶级地名数据集。 我们按照他们的性别 和受欢迎程度来排序名字, 只使用前500名的名字。 此外,我们使用罗森曼等人(2023年)提供的数据集对地名进行种族分类。

blocks.en: 3.2 Fill in the Blank Sentences
blocks.zh: 3.2 填写空白句子

blocks.en: To make the LLMs choose between two names, we constructed 30 sentence templates containing a placeholder for the model to supply a name. The sentences were all gender-neutral, and were designed to signal a person’s age or gender, to elicit biased behavior from a local large language model. Across all our sentences, only the scenario varied, and the syntactic structure remained constant to isolate how the model associated names with gender, age, and race cues. Some example sentences can be found below: • “_ just celebrated a 45th birthday” • “_ is hoping to contribute more to a 401K in the coming year” • “_ is getting ready to start high school in the spring” • “_ is filling out taxes for 2025.” • “_ is going to a 20th high school reunion”
blocks.zh: 为了让LLMs在两个名字中选择,我们构建了30个句子模板,包含一个占位符,供模型提供一个名字. 这些判决都是不分性别的,旨在表明一个人的年龄或性别,从而从当地大语言模式中引出有偏见的行为。 我们所有的句子中,只有情景各有不同,而综合结构保持不变,以隔离模型如何将名字与性别、年龄和种族提示联系起来。 举例来说,“刚庆祝了45岁生日”“希望在未来一年为401K捐款”“准备在春天开始中学学习””“2025年正在填税”。 • “__将参加第二十届高中同学会”

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Models
blocks.zh: 4.1 模式

blocks.en: We evaluate age, gender, popularity, and race bias across six contemporary language models spanning different scales and architectures. Our selection includes models from five major providers: Meta (Llama 3.2 1B Instruct), Google (Gemma 2 2B Instruct), Microsoft (Phi-3.5 Mini Instruct), Mistral AI (Mistral 7B Instruct v0.3), and Alibaba (Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct). This diversity allows us to assess whether age bias patterns are consistent across different model families, training paradigms, and parameter scales ranging from 1 billion to 7 billion parameters.
blocks.zh: 我们评价年龄、性别、受欢迎程度和种族偏见, 我们的选择包括五个主要供应商的模型: Meta (Llama 3.2 1B Instruct),Google (Gemma 2 2B Instruct),微软 (Phi-3.5 Mini Instruct),Mistral AI (Mistral 7B Instruct v0.3)和阿里巴巴 (Quen 2.5 7B Instruct). 这种多样性使我们能够评估不同模范家庭、培训范式以及从10亿到70亿参数的参数尺度是否一致。

blocks.en: Five open-source models were deployed locally using vLLM Kwon et al. (2023) , a high-throughput inference engine optimized for large language model serving with PagedAttention. Table 1 summarizes model configurations.
blocks.zh: 使用VLLM Kwon et al. (2023)在当地部署了5个开源模型,这是一个为PagedAttenty服务的大语言模型所优化的高通量推论引擎. 表1总结了模型配置.

blocks.en: Table 1: Model configurations and iteration counts. Each iteration generates 30 responses (one per sentence template), yielding 60,000 responses per model.
blocks.zh: 表1:模型配置和迭代计数. 每个迭代生成30个响应(每个句子模板一个),每个模型生成60,000个响应.

blocks.en: 4.2 Experimental Design
blocks.zh: 4.2 实验设计

blocks.en: Our experimental design aims to measure age bias while controlling for potential confounds, particularly gender associations and position effects. The core task presents models with fill-in-the-blank sentences and two name options, asking which name fits best in the given context.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验设计旨在衡量年龄偏差,同时控制潜在的混乱,特别是性别协会和职位效应。 核心任务呈现出有填充句子和两个取名选项的模型,询问哪个名称最适合特定上下文.

blocks.en: To isolate age bias from gender confounds, we employed an alternating experimental design with two conditions:
blocks.zh: 为了将年龄偏见与性别混乱区分开来,我们采用了一个交替的实验设计,有两个条件:

blocks.en: • Same Gender, Different Ages (even iterations: 0, 2, 4, …): Both names share the same gender (male or female, randomly selected per iteration), but differ in temporal cohort—one name from the 1980s, one from the 2010s. This condition directly measures age-based preferences, as the only systematic difference between names is their associated age cohort. • Different Genders, Same Age (odd iterations: 1, 3, 5, …): Names differ in gender (one male, one female) but share the same decade (1980s or 2010s, randomly selected per iteration). This control condition helps identify gender-based preferences independent of age effects.
blocks.zh: • 相同的性别、不同的年龄(甚至重复:0、2、4.):两个名字都具有相同的性别(男性或女性,每个重复随机选择),但时间组别不同——一个名字来自1980年代,一个名字来自2010年代。 这一条件直接衡量基于年龄的偏好,因为名字之间唯一的系统差异是其相关的年龄组。 • 不同性别、相同年龄(拼接:1、3、5.):性别名称不同(一名男性、一名女性),但共用同一十年(1980年代或2010年代,按每次重复随机选择)。 这种控制条件有助于确定不分年龄影响的基于性别的偏好。

blocks.en: Same Gender, Different Ages (even iterations: 0, 2, 4, …): Both names share the same gender (male or female, randomly selected per iteration), but differ in temporal cohort—one name from the 1980s, one from the 2010s. This condition directly measures age-based preferences, as the only systematic difference between names is their associated age cohort.
blocks.zh: 相同的性别,不同的年龄(甚至重复:0,2,4,.):两个名字都具有相同的性别(男性或女性,每个重复随机选择),但时间组别不同——一个名字来自1980年代,一个名字来自2010年代. 这一条件直接衡量基于年龄的偏好,因为名字之间唯一的系统差异是其相关的年龄组。

blocks.en: Different Genders, Same Age (odd iterations: 1, 3, 5, …): Names differ in gender (one male, one female) but share the same decade (1980s or 2010s, randomly selected per iteration). This control condition helps identify gender-based preferences independent of age effects.
blocks.zh: 不同性别,同年龄(拼接: 1, 3, 5,.):不同性别(一男一女)的名字不同,但共用同十年(1980年代或2010年代,每个同龄人随机选取). 这种控制条件有助于确定不分年龄影响的基于性别的偏好。

blocks.en: This alternating design ensures balanced representation of both conditions across the dataset. Names were sampled uniformly at random from the top 500 most popular names in each decade-gender category from the Social Security Administration (SSA) database. The uniform sampling strategy ensures equal representation across the name frequency spectrum, avoiding bias toward the most popular names. Within each query, the presentation order of the two options was randomized to mitigate position bias.
blocks.zh: 这种交替设计确保了两个条件在数据集的均衡代表性。 从社会保障管理局数据库中每十年性别类别中最受欢迎的500个名称中,统一随机抽样。 统一的取样战略确保了在名称频谱中的平等代表性,避免了对最受欢迎名称的偏见。 在每次查询中,对两个选项的演示顺序进行随机排列以缓解位置偏差.

blocks.en: The same-gender comparisons are critical for isolating age bias. By holding gender constant, any systematic preference for one name over another can be attributed to age associations rather than gender stereotypes. The different-gender comparisons serve as both a control and a separate investigation into potential gender biases in the same sentence contexts. This design enables us to distinguish between age-based and gender-based preferences in model responses.
blocks.zh: 同性别的比较对于隔离年龄偏见至关重要。 通过坚持性别不变,任何系统性地偏好一个名字而不是另一个名字,都可以归因于年龄协会,而不是性别陈规定型观念。 不同性别的比较既能控制又能单独调查同一句语中潜在的性别偏见。 这一设计使我们能够在示范对策中区分基于年龄和性别的偏好。

blocks.en: 4.3 Task and Prompting
blocks.zh: 4.3 任务和提示

blocks.en: We constructed 30 gender-neutral fill-in-the-blank sentences spanning diverse contexts that vary in age-indicativeness. Templates include explicit age markers (e.g., “_ just celebrated a 45th birthday”), age-suggestive contexts (retirement planning, school activities), and neutral scenarios (travel, purchases). All sentences use a single blank placeholder to maintain consistency in task difficulty.
blocks.zh: 我们构建了30个不分性别的填充句子,涵盖不同背景,年龄指标各不相同。 模板包括明确的年龄标记(例如,“_刚庆祝45岁生日”)、年龄暗示背景(退休规划、学校活动)和中性情景(旅行、购买)。 所有句子都使用单个空白的占位符来保持任务难度的一致性.

blocks.en: To ensure consistency across all models and avoid confounding effects from prompt variations, we used a single standardized prompt template:
blocks.zh: 为确保所有模型的一致性并避免迅速变化造成混淆,我们使用了单一的标准化即时模板:

blocks.en: Sentence: <sentence_template> Which fits best: "<name1>" or "<name2>"? Answer with just the text of the choice.
blocks.zh: 句子: < 判决_时速> 哪一种最合适:"""""""""""""""""""""""? 仅用选择的文字来回答.

blocks.en: The prompt format is deliberately minimal and neutral. The instruction “Answer with just the text of the choice” constrains responses to one of the two provided names, minimizing extraneous generation and facilitating automated analysis. All models used the system message “You are a helpful assistant” to maintain consistency.
blocks.zh: 即时格式是故意最小和中立的. 指令“仅用选择的文字回答”限制了对两个名称之一的答复,最大限度地减少了不相干生成,并促进了自动化分析。 所有模型都使用“你是一个有帮助的助手”的系统信息来保持一致性。

blocks.en: We employed consistent generation parameters across all models to ensure comparable stochasticity. The temperature was set to 0.7, balancing between deterministic and highly random behavior. This moderate temperature allows models to express subtle preferences while maintaining reasonable consistency across repeated trials. The maximum token limit was set to 512, though responses typically required fewer than 10 tokens.
blocks.zh: 我们在所有模型中采用了一致的生成参数,以确保可比较的分色。 温度被设定为0.7,平衡了确定性和高度随机的行为. 这种温和的温度使得模型能够表达微妙的偏好,同时在反复试验中保持合理的一致性. 最高令牌限额为512个,但答复通常要求少于10个令牌。

blocks.en: 4.4 Data Collection Protocol
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 数据收集协议

blocks.en: Data collection proceeded iteratively for each model. In each iteration, the system: (1) determined the comparison type based on iteration parity, (2) randomly selected appropriate name lists, (3) uniformly sampled two names, and (4) queried the model with all 30 sentence templates using randomized option orders.
blocks.zh: 每个模型的数据收集工作反复进行。 在每次迭代中,系统:(1)根据迭代等值确定比较类型,(2)随机选取适当名称列表,(3)统一抽取了两个名称,(4)使用随机选择命令,用全部30个句子模板询问模型.

blocks.en: This process yielded 30 responses per iteration. We collected 2,000 iterations for each open-source model, generating 60,000 responses per model. The cumulative dataset comprises 300,000 model responses .
blocks.zh: 这一过程每次收到30份答复。 我们为每个开源模型收集了2000个迭代,每个模型生成6万个响应. 累积数据集包括30万个模型答复。

blocks.en: 4.5 Infrastructure
blocks.zh: 4.5 基础设施

blocks.en: All experiments were conducted on the Nexus-vulcan cluster. Open-source models were deployed on NVIDIA RTX A5000 (24GB VRAM) and RTX A6000 (48GB VRAM) GPUs. We utilized vLLM Kwon et al. (2023) for efficient model serving with OpenAI-compatible API endpoints. Key serving parameters included: maximum context length of 2048 tokens (sufficient for our short prompts), maximum batch size of 8 concurrent sequences, and GPU memory utilization of 0.85 to prevent out-of-memory errors during extended collection runs.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都是在Nexus-vulcan集群上进行的。 开源模型被部署在NVIDIA RTX A5000(24GB VRAM)和RTX A600(48GB VRAM)GPU上. 我们利用vLLM Kwon等人(2023年)作为高效的模型,服务于OpenAI兼容的API端点. 关键服务参数包括:最大上下文长度为2048个令牌(足以满足我们的短提示),最大批量大小为8个并发序列,并使用GPU内存0.85来防止扩展收藏运行时出镜出错.

blocks.en: All model versions are pinned to specific Hugging Face repository snapshots to ensure reproducibility. Complete experimental artifacts, including server configurations, sampling procedures, and sentence templates, are available in our repository.
blocks.zh: 所有模型版本被固定在特定的Hugging Face寄存器快照上,以确保可再生. 完整的实验文物,包括服务器配置、取样程序和句子模板,可在我们的储存库中找到。

blocks.en: 4.6 Bias Estimation
blocks.zh: 4.6 偏见估计

blocks.en: To quantify name-driven bias in the evaluated LLMs, we used four complementary analyses:
blocks.zh: 为了量化所评价的有限责任公司中由名称驱动的偏差,我们使用了四项补充分析:

blocks.en: • Choice Likelihood : First, we estimated how likely a model was to choose each specific name for any prompt. This exposed which attributes were favored by the model, on average. The results of this analysis are shown in Figures 1 and 2 . • Relative Bias Between Sentences : Second, we measured the effects of different sentences on the relative levels of bias by asking how the distribution of names chosen for the sentence differed from the average. The results of this analysis are shown in Figure 3 . • Mixed-effects Modeling : Third, we fit a mixed-effects model to the chance that the second name in the pair shown to the LLM was chosen. Since the LLM showed extreme bias for the first name, this was an effective way to measure how a changing a demographic attribute affect that bias. We used the statsmodels package for this analysis, shown in Table 2 Seabold and Perktold (2010) . • Bias Correlation : Finally, we computed the correlations between biases within each model to assess whether models biased in one attribute (e.g. gender) are biased towards other attributes (e.g. race), which helps distinguish “one-factor” from multi-attribute biases. The results of this are shown in Figure 4 .
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 选择可能性: 首先,我们估计一个模型是否有可能为任何即时选择每个具体名称。 平均显示哪些属性受到模型的青睐。 分析结果如图1和图2所示。 判决之间的相对偏差:第二,我们衡量不同判决对相对偏差程度的影响,方法是询问为判决所选名字的分布与平均数有何不同。 分析结果见图3。 • 混合效应 建模 : 第三,我们搭配了一种混合效应模型,从而有可能选择了给LLM显示的对子中的第二个名字. 由于LLM表现出了对第一个名字的极端偏差,这是衡量人口属性变化如何影响这种偏差的有效方法. 我们使用统计模型包进行这一分析,见表2 Seabold和Perktold(2010年)。 最后,我们计算每个模型中偏差之间的关联,以评估一个属性(如性别)中偏差的模式是否偏向其他属性(如种族),这有助于区分“一因素”和多属性偏差。 其结果见图4。

blocks.en: Choice Likelihood : First, we estimated how likely a model was to choose each specific name for any prompt. This exposed which attributes were favored by the model, on average. The results of this analysis are shown in Figures 1 and 2 .
blocks.zh: 选择可能性: 首先,我们估计一个模型是否有可能为任何即时选择每个具体名称。 平均显示哪些属性受到模型的青睐。 分析结果见图1和图2。

blocks.en: Relative Bias Between Sentences : Second, we measured the effects of different sentences on the relative levels of bias by asking how the distribution of names chosen for the sentence differed from the average. The results of this analysis are shown in Figure 3 .
blocks.zh: 判决之间的相对偏差:第二,我们通过询问判决所选名称的分配与平均数有何不同,来衡量不同判决对相对偏差程度的影响。 分析结果见图3。

blocks.en: Mixed-effects Modeling : Third, we fit a mixed-effects model to the chance that the second name in the pair shown to the LLM was chosen. Since the LLM showed extreme bias for the first name, this was an effective way to measure how a changing a demographic attribute affect that bias. We used the statsmodels package for this analysis, shown in Table 2 Seabold and Perktold (2010) .
blocks.zh: 混合效应 建模 : 第三,我们搭配了一种混合效应模型,从而有可能选择了给LLM显示的对子中的第二个名字. 由于LLM表现出了对第一个名字的极端偏差,这是衡量人口属性变化如何影响这种偏差的有效方法. 我们使用了统计模型软件包进行这一分析,如表2 Seabold和Perktold(2010年)所示。

blocks.en: Bias Correlation : Finally, we computed the correlations between biases within each model to assess whether models biased in one attribute (e.g. gender) are biased towards other attributes (e.g. race), which helps distinguish “one-factor” from multi-attribute biases. The results of this are shown in Figure 4 .
blocks.zh: 偏见关联: 最后,我们计算每个模型中偏差之间的关联,以评估一个属性(如性别)中偏差的模式是否偏向其他属性(如种族),这有助于区分“一因素”和多属性偏差。 其结果见图4。

blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: Figure 1: Figure showing how the two largest sources of name-bias change for names ranked by how often LLMs choose them. As shown, generally, the LLMs favor more female and older names.
blocks.zh: 图 1:图显示名称排名的两个最大来源名称-比斯变化,用LLMs选择次数表示. 如所示,一般说来,LLMs更喜欢女性和更古老的名字.

blocks.zh: (a) 显示不同百分位地名的平均受欢迎程度如何变化,按偶然性排列。

blocks.zh: (b) 显示不同百分位地名的平均种族变化情况的数字,这些地名的排名是偶然的。

blocks.zh: (c) 显示不同百分位名称的平均符号长度变化情况的数字,这些名称的排序是偶然的。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Figure showing how the three smallest sources of name-bias change for names ranked by how often LLMs choose them. As shown, generally, the LLMs favor more popular, whiter names. Token count does not seem to affect the names they choose.
blocks.zh: 图 2:图显示名称排序最小的三个名称-比斯源的改变方式,用LLMs选择的次数表示. 如所显示,一般来说,LLMs倾向于更受欢迎更白的名称. 托肯计数似乎不影响他们选择的名字.

blocks.en: Across models, favored-name analysis indicated consistent preferences for more stereotypically white-associated names. We find that token length does not change for names more likely to be chosen than the average name. Figure 1 shows how the associated gender and age of the name change for names more likely to be chosen. Figure 2 shows how the popularity, associated race, and token length change for names more likely to be chosen.
blocks.zh: 在各种模型中,偏好名称分析表明,人们始终倾向于更陈规定型地使用与白人有关的名字。 我们发现,符号长度不会改变比一般名称更可能被选择的名称. 图1显示更可能选择姓名的相关性别和年龄变化。 图2显示更可能选择地名的受欢迎程度、相关种族和象征性长度的变化。

blocks.en: (a) Figure showing how the perceived gender of the names change for different sentences.
blocks.zh: (a) 显示不同句子名称的性别变化图。

blocks.en: (b) Figure showing how the perceived age of the names change for different sentences.
blocks.zh: (b) 显示不同句子名称的预期年龄变化图。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Figure showing how the perceived gender and age of the names change depending on the sentence. As shown, the Mistral LLM potentially promotes harmful biases, like saying female-sounding names are more likely to get in a fight with their spouse or older-sounding names are more likely to be a director at a company.
blocks.zh: 图3:显示姓名的性别和年龄因句子的不同而变化的图。 正如所显示的,Mistral LLM可能助长有害的偏见,比如说女声的名字更可能与其配偶发生争吵,或者更年长的名字更有可能成为一家公司的董事.

blocks.en: Bias is also highly sentence-dependent, with certain sentence prompts amplifying the models’ overall preference. When ranking prompts by how their bias differs from the overall, we find that the most biased prompts cluster around salient social and institutional contexts. These could perpetuate harmful stereotypes about the associated attributes. An example is that the prompt “_ recently got in a fight with a spouse” is more biased towards female-sounding names than the average prompt. Additionally, the distribution between more- and less-biased prompts largely aligns with societal expectations, where generic prompts like “_ and friends were playing with their toys” are associated with lower levels of bias than prompts like “_ is going to be the next director, managing 10 teams”. Two examples of this distribution are shown in Figure 3 .
blocks.zh: Bias也高度依赖句子, 当排名显示其偏见与整体不同时,我们发现,最有偏见的是围绕显著的社会和体制背景的集群。 这些因素可能延续对相关属性的有害定型观念。 一个例子是,“最近......与配偶发生争吵”的迅速情况比一般的迅速情况更偏向于女声的名字。 此外,更公正和更不带偏见的提示之间的分配基本上符合社会的期望,即“_和朋友在玩玩具”等通用提示比“_将担任下一位导演,管理10个团队”这样的提示具有较低的偏见。 这种分布的两个实例见图3。

blocks.en: Table 2: Table showing the output of the mixed effects modeling. As shown, the different sources of bias contribute in this order (high-to-low contribution): order of the names shown to the LLM (bias column), gender, age, popularity, and race.
blocks.zh: 表2:混合效果模型产出表. 如所显示的,不同偏见来源按这个顺序(从高到低的贡献):向LLM(比亚斯一栏)显示名字的顺序,性别,年龄,受欢迎程度和种族.

blocks.en: Mixed-effects modeling supports and sharpens these qualitative observations. We model the probability of selecting the second name over the first as a function of both difference Δ \Delta and sum ∑ \sum terms for each attribute, with a sentence term to capture prompt-level variation and a bias term to capture the models’ overall bias for the first option. Δ \Delta is interpreted as the change in the probability of moving option 1 to option 2 and ∑ \sum is the change in probability based on the presence of the attribute. Table 2 shows the log-odds from the mixed-effects model.
blocks.zh: 混合效应建模支持并强化了这些定性观测. 我们模拟从第一个名字中选择第二个名字的概率, 以作为每个属性的区别 \\ Delta 和 sum \ sum \ sum 术语的函数, 并用一个句子来捕捉即时的变异 和一个偏差词来捕捉模型对第一个选项的总体偏差 。 \\Delta被解释为将选项1移动到选项2的概率的变化;\\ sum是基于属性存在的概率变化. 表2显示混合效应模型的对数。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 2 , the bias column suggests that the models were between 22.08 22.08 and 2.49 2.49 times more likely to choose the first name than the second. Moving a stereotypically-male name to the second slot increased the chance of choosing the first by 1.28 → 2.20 1.28\to 2.20 times, and moving a stereotypically-older name increased the chance of choosing the second by 0.87 → 3.86 0.87\to 3.86 times. Additionally, moving a popular name increases the chance of choosing the second by 1.037 → 3.20 1.037\to 3.20 times and moving a stereotypically-white name increases the chance of choosing the second by 0.88 → 1.47 0.88\to 1.47 times. The associated whiteness of the name is taken from Nghiem et al. ’s dataset, while stereotypically-older names are names that were more popular in the 1980s SSA dataset. → \to represents the range between the model with the smallest and largest effect. The effects of moving a longer name, in terms of number of tokens, were not evaluated after Figure 2(c) showed that the number of tokens did not have a large effect on the name’s likelihood of being chosen.

blocks.en: Figure 4: The correlations between biases within each model. As shown, some models’ biases do not correlate, while other models show correlation between all of the biases or between specific biases.
blocks.zh: 图 4:每个模型中偏差的相互关系. 如所显示的,一些模型的偏差并不相关,而其他模型则显示出所有偏差之间或具体偏差之间的相关性。

blocks.en: Finally, correlation analysis shows that the bias dimensions co-vary substantially between different models. Some models, like Qwen2.5-7b in Figure 4(c) , only show a relationship between certain biases, like gender and race. However, other models, like Phi3.5-mini in Figure 4(a) , have strong correlations between each of their biases.
blocks.zh: 最后,关联性分析显示,不同模型之间的偏差维度在很大程度上相互交织. 一些模型,如图4(c)中的Quen2.5-7b,只显示出某些偏见之间的关系,如性别和种族。 然而,其他模型,如图4(a)中的Phi3.5-mini,在每一种偏差之间有着很强的关联.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: Taken together, these results indicate that name-bias is measurable across all evaluated models, but its magnitude and dominant drivers are model-specific. Despite that, we find that all models lean towards female-associated, older-associated, more popular, and more stereotypically white names. We include the length of the names, in tokens, as a possible confounder, but find it isn’t relevant in this analysis.
blocks.zh: 这些结果综合起来表明,在所有评价的模型中,名称比亚斯是可以衡量的,但其规模和主要驱动因素是针对模型的。 尽管如此,我们发现所有模型都倾向于女性关联,更古老的关联,更受欢迎,更陈规定型的白色名. 我们把名字的长度作为可能的混淆者,

blocks.en: While prompts do modulate the strength of these biases, the overall pattern suggests that name-linked stereotypes remain a strong signal shaping an LLM’s choice. This suggests the sentence acts as an amplifier of existing biases rather than determining them.
blocks.zh: 虽然提示确实调和了这些偏见的强度,但总体模式表明,与姓名有关的定型观念仍然是塑造LLM选择的强烈信号。 这表明该句是现有偏见的放大剂,而不是决定这些偏见。

blocks.en: Mixed-effect modeling shows that the relative strength of attributes matches the observed change in the attributes in more likely-to-be-chosen names. This quantifies the bias, showing how large the effect can be for some of the attributes.
blocks.zh: 混合效应模型显示,属性的相对强度与观测到的更可能选择名称的属性变化相匹配. 这可以量化偏差,显示某些属性的效果可以有多大.

blocks.en: Finally, we analyze the correlation between different biases within the LLMs, and find large levels of variation. This suggests that coupling between biases is not universal.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们分析法学硕士课程中不同偏差之间的关联,并发现很大程度的差异。 这表明偏见之间的结合不是普遍的。

blocks.en: While our trials are contrived examples, it is easy to see how name bias could negatively affect society and businesses. Several recent works have suggested using LLMs to review résumés for applicants for jobs Gan et al. (2024) . Asking that system to choose between two applicants, or score two applicants in reference to each other, is a direct analog of our tests. In this example, choosing a worse applicant because of these biases systematically has obvious detrimental effects to the business, society, and the applicant. However, this form of name bias is already seen when humans review a résumé, making it hard to know if LLMs will help remove or add to the level of bias of the human reviewers Bertrand and Mullainathan (2004) .
blocks.zh: 虽然我们的审判是精心策划的例子,但很容易看出名称偏见会如何对社会和企业产生负面影响。 最近的一些工作建议使用LLMs来审查Gan等人(2024年)职位申请人的简历。 要求该制度在两个申请人之间作出选择,或者相互参照对两个申请人进行评分,是直接模拟我们的测试。 在这个例子中,由于这些偏见而有计划地选择一个更差的申请者,显然对企业、社会和申请者产生不利影响。 然而,当人类审查简历时,人们已经看到这种名称偏向的形式,因此很难知道LLMs是否会帮助去除或增加人类审查者伯特兰和穆莱纳坦(2004年)的偏向程度.

blocks.en: 6.1 Contributions
blocks.zh: 6.1 缴款

blocks.en: This work provides a model-comparative, measurement-driven characterization of name-triggered bias in local LLMs. We ( i ) demonstrate how name-driven bias is consistently detectable across models, ( ii ) show that different models have biases that trend towards the same associated attributes, ( iii ) quantify how bias for different attributes contribute to an LLM’s preference for a name while controlling for prompt effects, ( iv ) and we analyze bias coupling to identify when they appear aligned vs separable within a given model.
blocks.zh: 这项工作为本地LLMs中的名字触发偏好提供了模型比较,测量驱动的特征. 我们(一) 演示名称驱动的偏差如何在模型中始终被察觉,(二) 显示不同的模型有偏差,这种偏差趋向于相同的相关属性,(三) 量化不同属性的偏差如何有助于LLM对名称的偏好,同时控制即时效应,(四) 我们分析偏差耦合,以识别这些偏差在某一模型中看似对等相对于可分离的偏差.

blocks.en: 6.2 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6.2 限制

blocks.en: Our evaluation is intentionally contrived: a forced binary choice in short templates does not reflect open-ended generation tasks or real decision workflows. Instead, it primarily tests associative preference over downstream harm.
blocks.zh: 我们的评价是故意设计的:在短模板中强制二进制选择并不反映开放式生成任务或真正的决策工作流程. 相反,它主要检验关联性优于下游损害。

blocks.en: The name sets are U.S.-centric, taken from the U.S. Social Security Administration dataset, and decade-bucketed. Additionally, the race annotations are from an association dataset and are not necessarily ground-truth labels. Both of these choices may introduce measurement error or limit the generalization of our work.
blocks.zh: 名称集以美国为中心,取自美国社会保障管理局的数据集,并被"十年被打". 此外,种族说明来自协会数据集,不一定是地面真实标签。 这两种选择都可能引入测量错误或限制我们工作的概括。

blocks.en: Although we randomize option order and use standardized prompts, prompt sensitivity or hyperparameters like temperature may affect measured effect sizes. Finally, our correlation and mixed-effect analyses are observational and quantify associations between attributes. They do not necessarily establish causal mechanisms within the model.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们随机排列选项顺序并使用标准化的提示,但如温度那样的即时灵敏度或超参数可能会影响被测量的效果大小. 最后,我们的相关性和混合效应分析是观测和量化属性之间的关联。 它们不一定在模式内建立因果机制。

blocks.en: 6.3 Future Work
blocks.zh: 6.3 未来工作

blocks.en: Assessing the bias of an LLM that reviews résumés is a logical follow-on project for this work. We propose that a similar methodology as Bertrand and Mullainathan could be employed to test how an LLM changes the bias of a résumé reviewer.
blocks.zh: 评估审查履历的LLM的偏差是这项工作合乎逻辑的后续项目. 我们建议,可以采用与Bertrand和Mullainathan类似的方法来检验LLM如何改变简历审查员的偏见。

blocks.en: Furthermore, we suggest two direct extensions of our work. First, we can adapt metamorphic testing to name bias by defining controlled transformations over prompts and name substitutions, and then auditing systematic violations across models. This is a known methodology for conducting tests of LLM bias da Silva de Oliveira et al. (2025) ; Reddy et al. (2025) . Second, we can operationalize these findings into standardized name-bias evaluation sets for developers to report, compare, and mitigate bias within their LLMs.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们建议直接延长我们的工作。 首先,我们可以调整变形测试,通过定义控制下的变换大于提示和名替代,然后对跨模型的系统违规情况进行审计来命名偏差. 这是对LLM偏差da Silva de Oliveira等人(2025年);Reddy等人(2025年)进行测试的已知方法。 其次,我们可以将这些结论应用到标准化的名称比喻评价集中,以便开发人员报告、比较和减少其有限责任管理框架内的偏差。
